cases.question: 截至2026-10-12，最近七天含运费的支付销售额是多少？
cases.query_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_revenue_cents) AS sales_cents FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-10-06' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_total_cents::numeric) AS sales_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-06' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13'

cases.question: 截至2026-10-12，本月含运费支付销售额是多少？
cases.query_sql: SELECT SUM(gross_revenue_cents) AS sales_cents FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_total_cents::numeric) AS sales_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13'

cases.question: 分别统计最近七天商品实付、运费和总支付金额，单位为分。
cases.query_sql: SELECT SUM(goods_revenue_cents) AS goods_cents, SUM(shipping_revenue_cents) AS shipping_cents, SUM(gross_revenue_cents) AS gross_cents FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-10-06' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.goods_paid_cents::numeric) AS goods_cents, SUM(o.shipping_paid_cents::numeric) AS shipping_cents, SUM(o.paid_total_cents::numeric) AS gross_cents FROM public.orders o WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-06' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13'

cases.question: 本月支付订单群截至查询时的已完成模拟退款订单率是多少？保留百分比两位。
cases.query_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(completed_refund_order_count) / NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count), 0), 2) AS refund_rate_percent FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)::numeric, 0), 2) AS refund_rate_percent FROM public.orders o LEFT JOIN public.refund_requests r ON r.order_id = o.id AND r.status = 'completed_simulated' WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13'

cases.question: 2099-01-01无订单时，退款率应为NULL，而非零或除零错误。
cases.query_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(completed_refund_order_count) / NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count), 0), 2) AS refund_rate_percent FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date = DATE '2099-01-01'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)::numeric, 0), 2) AS refund_rate_percent FROM public.orders o LEFT JOIN public.refund_requests r ON r.order_id = o.id AND r.status = 'completed_simulated' WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = DATE '2099-01-01'

cases.question: 对比2026-09-29至10-05与10-06至10-12的支付订单量。
cases.query_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN business_date < DATE '2026-10-06' THEN paid_order_count ELSE 0 END) AS previous_week_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN business_date >= DATE '2026-10-06' THEN paid_order_count ELSE 0 END) AS current_week_orders FROM ea_analytics.daily_orders WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-09-29' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13'
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-06' THEN 1::numeric ELSE 0::numeric END) AS previous_week_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-06' THEN 1::numeric ELSE 0::numeric END) AS current_week_orders FROM public.orders o WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-09-29' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13'

cases.question: 本月商品实付销售额最高的五个商品快照分组是什么？
cases.query_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, category, SUM(goods_revenue_cents) AS sales_cents FROM ea_analytics.daily_product_sales WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND business_date < DATE '2026-10-13' GROUP BY product_id, product_name, category ORDER BY sales_cents DESC, product_id, product_name, category LIMIT 5
cases.reference_sql: SELECT i.product_id::bigint AS product_id, i.product_name::text AS product_name, i.category::text AS category, SUM(i.paid_amount_cents::numeric) AS sales_cents FROM public.orders o JOIN public.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered') AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date < DATE '2026-10-13' GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name, i.category ORDER BY sales_cents DESC, product_id, product_name, category LIMIT 5
